services_heading: Complete Plumbing and Heating Services Across Sunderland

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We're on call 24/7 and carry parts on every van to avoid repeat visits.

services.title: Boiler Installation and Replacement
services.desc: New combi, system, and conventional boilers fitted by Gas Safe engineers. All work guaranteed for 10 years.

services.desc: Annual services to keep your boiler running safely and efficiently. Most repairs completed same day.

services.title: Central Heating System Installation
services.desc: Full system design and installation for new builds and renovations. Power flushing included to clear sludge and corrosion.

services.title: Radiator Installation and Balancing
services.desc: New radiators fitted, old ones removed, and systems balanced to ensure even heat throughout your home.

services.title: Pipework and Plumbing Alterations
services.desc: Kitchen and bathroom pipework, en-suite installations, and water supply upgrades carried out to Building Regulations.

about_pullquote: We started Eden Vale because we got tired of seeing Sunderland folk ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: Eden Vale Plumbing and Heating Services was founded over 12 years ago by a team of Gas Safe registered engineers frustrated with the lack of honest, fast plumbing service in Sunderland. We've grown from a one-man operation to a respected local business completing over 2,500 jobs, from burst pipes at midnight to full central heating system overhauls.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up when we say we will, fixing the problem right the first time, and charging a fair price with no hidden extras. We're not the cheapest—but we're reliable, we guarantee our work, and nine out of ten customers come back to us or recommend us to their neighbours.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe at half ten on a Saturday night. Rang Eden Vale expecting to wait until Monday—they were here in 50 minutes. Fixed it properly, explained what had gone wrong, and the price was spot on. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in just before Christmas. Bit panicky but the lads diagnosed a faulty valve, ordered the part, and came back the next day to fit it. Professional throughout, and they left the place spotless. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Angela P.

reviews.text: Been with Eden Vale for years now. Every service appointment is on time, they're always honest about what needs doing, and the quality of work is excellent. Best plumber in Sunderland as far as I'm concerned.
reviews.author: David H.
